description: Redis stores values under keys and offers useful data structures. It often keeps fast temporary data such as counts and queues. Learn its strings, lists and sets with clearly named practice keys. Use a local Redis server and redis-cli. Commands here use cma: practice keys only. Redis commands do not run in the site's SQLite playground. Do not connect these exercises to a production database.
versionNote: Uses stable Redis core commands for strings, hashes, collections and transactions.
whatYouWillLearn: Learn to add one more INCR and predict the value
